task.name: stack_cup_cola
task.description: Use the left arm to pick up the purple cup and place it in the blue bowl. Then use the right arm to pick up the red coke can and place it into the purple cup.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the purple cup.
2. Grasp the purple cup with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the blue bowl.
4. Release the gripper to place the purple cup into the blue bowl.
5. Move the right arm to approach and align with the red coke can.
6. Grasp the red coke can with the right arm.
7. Move the right arm to align with the purple cup.
8. Release the gripper to place the red coke can into the purple cup.
